sql: SELECT y.trip_date, y.avg_total_amount, h.holiday_name, CASE WHEN h.holiday_name IS NOT NULL THEN 'holiday' ELSE 'regular' END AS day_type FROM whybot.yellow_daily y LEFT JOIN whybot.us_holidays h ON h.holiday_date = y.trip_date WHERE y.trip_date IN (DATE '2025-01-13', DATE '2025-01-20', DATE '2025-01-27') ORDER BY y.trip_date LIMIT 500
